_comment_1: Clippy backend config — JSON template. Copy to config.json and edit.
_comment_2: config.json is denied by .htaccess so it is safe to put API keys here.
_comment_3: Pure JSON (no comments). Keys starting with _ are ignored by the adapter and can hold human notes like the ones above.
_about_allowed_origins: Leave [] for same-origin-only. Add exact origins like 'https://docs.example.com' if Clippy is embedded on a different origin than this adapter. ['*'] is allowed but dev-only.
_about_default_provider: Which provider handles a request when no model-based route matches.
_about_providers: Per-provider settings. Each provider also lists the models the browser may pick in its dropdown. Only the 'label' and 'models' subset is served to the browser by models.php; secrets (api_key, base_url, timeout) never leave the server.
_about_anthropic_example: Scaffolding — remove the leading underscore and move this block into 'providers' when you're ready to wire Anthropic up. Needs a matching providers/anthropic.php.
_about_routes: Optional model-based routing. Maps PCRE patterns (as strings) against the request's model field to a provider name. Empty today.
